usage: `r.Water.ShallowWaterMaxDynamicForces=<值>` / `r.Water.ShallowWaterMaxDynamicForces <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Max number of dynamic forces that will be registered with sim at a time.

usage: `r.Water.ShallowWaterMaxImpulseForces=<值>` / `r.Water.ShallowWaterMaxImpulseForces <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Max number of impulse forces that will be registered with sim at a time.

usage: `r.Water.ShallowWaterRenderTargetSize=<值>` / `r.Water.ShallowWaterRenderTargetSize <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Size for square shallow water fluid sim render target. Effective dimensions are SizexSize

usage: `r.Water.SingleLayer=<值>` / `r.Water.SingleLayer <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Enable the single water rendering system.

usage: `r.Water.SingleLayer.DistanceFieldShadow=<值>` / `r.Water.SingleLayer.DistanceFieldShadow <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: When using deferred, distance field shadow tracing is supported on single layer water. This cvar can be used to toggle it on/off at runtime.

usage: `r.Water.SingleLayer.MobileFallback=<值>` / `r.Water.SingleLayer.MobileFallback <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Whether to use a translucent rendering fallback for a single layer water on mobile platforms

usage: `r.Water.SingleLayer.Reflection=<值>` / `r.Water.SingleLayer.Reflection <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Reflection technique to use on single layer water. 0: Disabled, 1: Enabled (same as rest of scene), 2: Force Reflection Captures and Sky, 3: Force SSR

usage: `r.Water.SingleLayer.Reflection.Denoising=<值>` / `r.Water.SingleLayer.Reflection.Denoising <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Whether to use denoising for Single Layer Water reflection traces. Adds some cost and makes reflections softer, but removes noise and flickering.

usage: `r.Water.SingleLayer.Reflection.DownsampleCheckerboard=<值>` / `r.Water.SingleLayer.Reflection.DownsampleCheckerboard <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Whether to use checkerboard downsampling when DownsampleFactor is greater than one.

usage: `r.Water.SingleLayer.Reflection.DownsampleFactor=<值>` / `r.Water.SingleLayer.Reflection.DownsampleFactor <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Downsample factor for Single Layer Water Reflection. Downsampling will introduce extra noise, so it's recommend to be used together with denoising (r.Water.SingleLayer.Reflection.Denoiser 1).

usage: `r.Water.SingleLayer.Reflection.ScreenSpaceReconstruction=<值>` / `r.Water.SingleLayer.Reflection.ScreenSpaceReconstruction <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Whether to use screen space reconstruction for Single Layer Water reflection traces. Usually not needed, as water has mostly mirror reflections.

usage: `r.Water.SingleLayer.RefractionDownsampleFactor=<值>` / `r.Water.SingleLayer.RefractionDownsampleFactor <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Resolution divider for the water refraction buffer.

usage: `r.Water.SingleLayer.SSRTAA=<值>` / `r.Water.SingleLayer.SSRTAA <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Enable SSR denoising using TAA for the single layer water rendering system.

usage: `r.Water.SingleLayer.TiledComposite=<值>` / `r.Water.SingleLayer.TiledComposite <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Enable tiled optimization of the single layer water reflection rendering system.

usage: `r.Water.SingleLayer.VSMFiltering=<值>` / `r.Water.SingleLayer.VSMFiltering <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: When using deferred, virtual shadow map filtering is supported on single layer water. This cvar can be used to toggle it on/off at runtime.

usage: `r.Water.SingleLayer.WaveOps=<值>` / `r.Water.SingleLayer.WaveOps <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Whether Single Layer Water should use wave ops if supported.

usage: `r.Water.UnderwaterCollisionPreciseTraceDistance=<值>` / `r.Water.UnderwaterCollisionPreciseTraceDistance <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Underwater precise collision trace distance. Verifies precise overlap between camera and volume when camera is underneath the water collision impact location

usage: `r.Water.UnderwaterCollisionTraceDistance=<值>` / `r.Water.UnderwaterCollisionTraceDistance <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Underwater post processing collision trace distance. Default is inflated to account for waves which will not be hit by trace

usage: `r.Water.WaterMesh.LODCountBias=<值>` / `r.Water.WaterMesh.LODCountBias <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: This value is added to the LOD Count of each Water Mesh Component. Negative values will lower the quality(fewer and larger water tiles at the bottom level of the water quadtree), higher values will increase quality (more and smaller water tiles at the bottom level of the water quadtree)

usage: `r.Water.WaterMesh.LODMorphEnabled=<值>` / `r.Water.WaterMesh.LODMorphEnabled <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: If the smooth LOD morph is enabled. Turning this off may cause slight popping between LOD levels but will skip the calculations in the vertex shader, making it cheaper

usage: `r.Water.WaterMesh.LODScaleBias=<值>` / `r.Water.WaterMesh.LODScaleBias <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: This value is added to the LOD Scale of each Mesh Component. Negative values will lower the overall density/resolution or the vertex grid and make the LODs smaller, higher values will increase the density/resolution and make the LODs larger. Smallest value is -0.5. That will make the inner LOD as tight and optimized as possible

usage: `r.Water.WaterMesh.MaxDimensionInTiles=<值>` / `r.Water.WaterMesh.MaxDimensionInTiles <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Maximum dimension of a water mesh in tiles (max of either X or Y). If a water mesh attempts to generate a quadtree with more than this many tiles in X or Y, it will be biased back below this threshold via the same process as the LODScaleBias (iteratively dividing tile size by 2 until compliance). Having too many tiles can create very large GPU allocations.

usage: `r.Water.WaterMesh.OcclusionCullExpandBoundsAmountXY=<值>` / `r.Water.WaterMesh.OcclusionCullExpandBoundsAmountXY <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Expand the water tile bounds in XY for the purpose of occlusion culling

usage: `r.Water.WaterMesh.OcclusionCulling=<值>` / `r.Water.WaterMesh.OcclusionCulling <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Enables occlusion culling for the CPU water quadtree.

usage: `r.Water.WaterMesh.OcclusionCulling.IncludeFarMesh=<值>` / `r.Water.WaterMesh.OcclusionCulling.IncludeFarMesh <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: When occlusion culling is enabled, always do occlusion queries for the water far mesh, independent of r.Water.WaterMesh.OcclusionCulling.MaxQueries.

usage: `r.Water.WaterMesh.OcclusionCulling.MaxQueries=<值>` / `r.Water.WaterMesh.OcclusionCulling.MaxQueries <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Maximum number of occlusion queries for the CPU water quadtree nodes. Using fewer queries than nodes will result in coarser culling.

usage: `r.Water.WaterMesh.TessFactorBias=<值>` / `r.Water.WaterMesh.TessFactorBias <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: This value is added to the tessellation factor of each Mesh Component. Negative values will lower the overall density/resolution or the vertex grid, higher values will increase the density/resolution
